title: Simple Variable Mass 6DOF ECEF (Quaternion)
text: Implement quaternion representation of six-degrees-of-freedom equations of motion of simple variable mass in Earth-centered Earth-fixed (ECEF) coordinates, 6 inputs, 14 outputs, {Mass type} sets Mass type Simple; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Initial position in geodetic latitude, longitude and altitude [mu,l,h]} sets the initial location of rigid body, {Initial velocity in body axes [U,v,w]} sets the velocity in body axes, {Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw]} sets the initial Euler orientation, {Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]} sets the initial body rotation, {Initial mass}, {Empty mass}, {Full mass}, {Inertia}, {Empty inertia}, {Full inertia}, {Include mass flow relative velocity} sets the mass flow relative velocity port, {Include inertial acceleration}, {Planet model}, {Equatorial radius} sets the radius of planet at equator, {Flattening}, {Rotational rate}, {Celestial longitude of Greenwich source} sets the source of Greenwich meridian initial celestial longitude, {Celestial longitude of Greenwich [deg]} sets the initial angle, {Celestial longitude of prime meridian source} sets the source of prime meridian initial celestial longitude, {Celestial longitude of prime meridian [deg]} sets the initial angle, {Quaternion vector: e.g., ’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’} sets the quaternion vector state name, {Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’} sets the body rotation state names, {Velocity: e.g., ’U’,’v’,’w’} sets the velocity state name, {Fixed frame position: e.g., ’Xff’, ’Yff’, ’Zff’} sets the eCEF position state name, {Inertial position: e.g., ’Xinertial’, ’Yinertial’, ’Zinertial’} sets the inertial position state names, {Celestial longitude of Greenwich: e.g., ’LG’} sets the celestial longitude state name, {Celestial longitude of prime meridian: e.g., ’LPM’} sets the celestial longitude prime meridian and {Mass: e.g., ’mass’} sets the mass state name. Values come from the instance.
